title: Harbor launch
synopsis: Unreleased launch film for the MIRA hull. The master never leaves this workstation. The talent is unreleased and must be blurred before publish.

transcript.text: MIRA. The hull clears the dock tonight.
Hold on the name as the crane swings through.

scripted_cloud.summary: Logo reveal on the line 'hold on the name': hold the MIRA wordmark from 03.900 to 04.800 for the beat, lower third up front, talent blurred.

scripted_cloud_revision.summary: Revised after the workstation's check: the crane load covers the name from 03.708 to 05.333, so the reveal now leads the line, 01.200 to 02.400, while the wordmark is clear.
